circumstances_desc: 5,478,088 Units were issued pursuant to the trust deed constituting OUE REIT dated 10 October 2013 (as amended) (the “Trust Deed”) as payment for 50.0% of the Base Fee (as defined in the Trust Deed) for the period from 1 April 2026 to 30 June 2026. Pursuant to an arrangement between the Manager and OUE, the 5,478,088 Units were issued directly to OUE.
title: Oue Limited None transaction of OUE Real Estate Investment Trust
body: Oue Limited executed a transaction for 5,478,088 shares of OUE Real Estate Investment Trust. This increases their holdings from 2,708,394,902 to 2,713,872,990 shares.
